# Ash of Ancillaries (`ash-of-ancillaries`)

Ancillary invoice review for nursing homes: pharmacy, therapy, lab, radiology and supply charges for residents not in the building, for residents whose own payer should be billed instead, outside Part A consolidated billing, above contract rates or duplicated, with credit request drafts a person approves and sends. Resident identifiers are masked before results reach the model.

**Ash never holds, releases or changes vendor payments.**

Evergreen ver 1 · Financial services · MIT · Node 20 or newer · local files only · resident and staff identifiers masked before results reach the model · built on [`evergreen-core`](../evergreen-core)

```bash
npx -y ash-of-ancillaries demo
npx -y ash-of-ancillaries mcp --root ./facility-files
```

## What the sample data shows

Fictional Cedar Hollow pharmacy and lab invoices for March 2026. Planted:

- R1901: apixaban billed twice on 4 March, a lab panel billed at 38 against a 14 contract rate, and a code on the consolidated billing exclusion list (`J9035`, a fictional example) billed to the facility during a Part A stay.
- R1902: on Medicaid, so the pharmacy should bill Medicaid, not the facility.
- R1903: discharged 12 March, but billed for 14 March.
- R1904: billed insulin on 16 March, while in the hospital. The 20 March line is fine.

`drafts/credit_request-example000001.md` is a fixed draft for the one-click approval cases. [`rules-typo.json`](fixtures/rules-typo.json) misspells a setting, so the check refuses it.

## Tools

| Tool | What it does | Policy |
|---|---|---|
| `ash_check` | Check each ancillary line against the census, the payer and the contract rate. | runs |
| `ash_write_report` | Write ash-ancillaries.csv (one row per item, with blank owner and decision columns) and ash-ancillaries.html into out_dir (default evergreen-out/ash). | runs |
| `ash_draft_credit_request` | Write a credit request for one vendor invoice listing every disputed line with the reason and amount. | asks first |
| `ash_request_send` | After one named human click (even in Auto), record that the reviewed credit request draft is approved in credit_request-requests.csv. | one named click, even in Auto (`binding_send`) |
| `ash_recall` | Search this agent's own memory of the customer's setup: accepted facts (in use) and facts waiting for a person. | runs |
| `ash_learn` | Propose one fact about the customer's setup for this agent to remember. | runs |
| `ash_accept_learning` | A named person accepts or rejects a fact waiting in this agent's memory. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `ash_retire_memory` | A named person stops an accepted fact from applying. | one named click, even in Auto (`accept_learning`) |
| `vendor_payment_hold` | Ash never holds, releases or changes vendor payments. | refused |

Any tool name not in this table is blocked, including names a model invents. Refused tools are listed so a model can see they exist and are refused.

### `ash_check` arguments

| Argument | What it is |
|---|---|
| `invoices` (required) | Ancillary invoice lines under --root: vendor, vendor type (pharmacy, therapy, lab, radiology, supply), invoice, resident, date, code, description, quantity, amount |
| `census` (required) | Census under --root covering the invoice dates |
| `rates` | Optional contract rates under --root: vendor, code, rate |
| `rules` | Optional rules JSON: snf_pays_for, cb_excluded_codes, facility_name |
| `status` | Only items with this status |
| `limit` | Most items to return to the model (the report file always has all of them) |

## Columns it reads

Tables can be CSV, TSV, semicolon- or pipe-separated text, Excel `.xlsx`, JSON or JSONL. Columns are matched by the names below (any case and punctuation), and by their usual names in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Chinese and Korean. Dates become `YYYY-MM-DD`. Columns marked *masked* hold resident or staff identifiers.

The PointClickCare, MatrixCare and American HealthTech style names were written from public help pages and general knowledge, **not checked against real exports**. Run `npx ash-of-ancillaries inspect <file>` (column names and shapes only, never values) and name any column it misses in `remedy-sources.json`.

### Ancillary invoices (`invoices`)

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `vendor` (required) | text | Vendor, Provider, Supplier, Vendor Name |
| `vendor_type` | text | Vendor Type, Service Type, Category, Type |
| `invoice_no` | text | Invoice, Invoice #, Invoice Number, Statement |
| `resident_id` | text (masked) | Resident ID, Resident #, Resident Number, Res ID, Res #, MRN, Medical Record Number, Client ID |
| `resident_name` | text (masked) | Resident, Resident Name, Name, Patient, Patient Name, Client Name, Resident Full Name |
| `date` (required) | date | Date, Service Date, DOS, Dispense Date, Fill Date |
| `code` | text | Code, NDC, CPT, HCPCS, Item Code, Item |
| `description` | text | Description, Drug, Item Description, Service |
| `qty` | number | Qty, Quantity, Units |
| `amount` (required) | amount | Amount, Amt, Total, Balance, Net Amount, Payment Amount, Paid, Paid Amount |

| `to` | date | To, End, End Date, Thru, Through, Thru Date, Through Date, To Date |
| `payer` (required) | text | Payer, Payer Name, Primary Payer, Pay Source, Payer Source, Payor, Payor Name, Insurance |
| `payer_type` | text | Payer Type, Payor Type, Payer Class, Payer Category, Pay Type |
| `level` | text | Level, Level of Care, Care Level, Rate Type, Rate Level, Room Type, Accommodation, RUG |

| Column | Type | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| `vendor` (required) | text | Vendor, Provider, Supplier, Vendor Name |
| `code` (required) | text | Code, NDC, CPT, HCPCS, Item Code |
| `rate` (required) | amount | Rate, Contract Rate, Price, Unit Price |

## Settings file (`ash_rules`)

A small JSON file you pass by path. A misspelled setting is refused by name rather than ignored, so a typo never silently changes a check.

| Setting | What it does |
|---|---|
| `snf_pays_for` | Payer types whose ancillaries the facility pays for (default medicare_a and managed_care; check each managed care contract) |
| `cb_excluded_codes` | Codes outside Part A consolidated billing, from the current CMS exclusion lists |
| `facility_name` | Facility name for credit requests |

## Memory

`ash_learn` only proposes a fact; nothing changes until a named person accepts it with `ash_accept_learning`, which is one click even in Auto. Facts live in a hash-chained file under `.remedy/memory/`; if the chain does not verify, no fact is used. Credentials, personal identifiers and text that reads like instructions to an AI are refused.

| Kind | What an accepted fact does |
|---|---|
| `vendor_contact` | is shown with results. It never changes a check. |

## Install

Node 20 or newer. No other runtime dependencies besides `evergreen-core` and `remedy-core`.

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "ash-of-ancillaries": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": [
        "-y",
        "ash-of-ancillaries",
        "mcp",
        "--root",
        "/path/to/facility-files"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

Claude Code: `claude mcp add ash-of-ancillaries -- npx -y ash-of-ancillaries mcp --root .`, or use the plugin files in this folder.

## CLI

```bash
ash-of-ancillaries tools                 # every tool, its policy and arguments
ash-of-ancillaries sources               # the columns each input is read from
ash-of-ancillaries inspect <file>        # how a file would be read (names and shapes, never values)
ash-of-ancillaries call ash_check '{"invoices":"<invoices>","census":"<census>"}'
ash-of-ancillaries eval                  # the private eval cases on the fictional fixtures
ash-of-ancillaries demo
```

## Resident and staff data

Results go to an AI model, so identifiers are masked before they leave the agent: resident and staff names become stable pseudonyms such as `PT-3f9a1c2e`, record and account numbers become `MRN-…` or `ACCT-…`, and e-mails and phone numbers are removed, also inside free text. Report files written to disk keep real names because staff work from them: keep them in a folder only your staff can open. The shared tests check that no fictional identifier from the fixtures reaches any eval result, and the hostile-input check plants spreadsheet formulas, HTML and AI-aimed instructions in the data. This keeps PHI away from the model; it is **not** a HIPAA compliance determination. Your business associate agreements, access controls and policies still apply.

## Limits

- Reads only the files you give it. It does not log in to PointClickCare, MatrixCare, a payer portal, a bank, a state Medicaid portal or a payroll system.
- Medicare, Medicaid and payroll rules are summarised from public material as of 2026 and the numbers are settings you supply; a billing, payroll or legal professional checks them before you rely on them.
- Not legal, tax, accounting, clinical, reimbursement or HIPAA advice. A person decides what to bill, pay, appeal, file or send.
- Every call is written to a hash-chained audit log under `.remedy/` in the root. No network calls, no telemetry, no credentials. The bundled data is fictional.
